structure.unit: Professions and Occupations Regulated by Boards Within the Department of Health Professions

law.catch_line: Active duty military personnel or their spouses
law.text:
A licensee who is active duty military or is the spouse of an individual who is active duty military may designate one of the following as the home state:
Home of record;
Permanent Change of Station (PCS); or
State of current residence if it is different from the PCS state or home of record.
